post_title: Update on HR 875 Act Mandates Immediate Deportation for DUI Offenses (Incl Past DUIs)
concerns_or_questions_summary: News update summarizing H.R. 875, a bipartisan House bill that would make any DUI/DWI conviction grounds for automatic deportation of visa holders, green card holders, and undocumented immigrants, including decades-old pleas. The bill passed the House 246-160 and awaits a Senate vote and presidential signature.
